summary: Current main retained a committed Full+MAMBA node as a discoverable host leaf after device eviction and restored both components through real D2H/H2D fixture transfers. Added a focused regression for host LRU, locks, accounting, numerical restoration, and absent/incomplete host-state negatives. The original TP4 hybrid-KDA deployment was not available.

tests.what_was_measured: Baseline behavior on the prepared implementation: backed-up leaf demotion, MAMBA host-LRU movement, host-prefix discovery, and exact Full+MAMBA restoration through real cache-controller transfers; 4 passed.

Focused contract: committed dual host state survives device eviction, remains discoverable, obeys host LRU/locking/accounting, and numerically restores Full KV plus MAMBA temporal/conv state. Negative cases verify no fabricated MAMBA load-back and pruning of MAMBA-only incomplete state; 3 passed.

gpu_evidence: Raw logs identify AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950. Full KV and MAMBA temporal/convolution buffers were seeded on GPU, transferred D2H, evicted, transferred H2D, and compared exactly with pre-eviction CPU snapshots. raw/gpu_numerical_reference.txt also records an exact GPU-vs-CPU matmul comparison.
remaining_limitations: No Ling-3.0-flash or other hybrid-KDA model weights were provided.
Only one assigned GPU was exposed, so the reported TP4 serving workload was not reproduced.
The small unified-cache fixture validates component state and real transfer behavior, not distributed serving, model semantics, or the full deployment.

The upstream issue remains open; current main appears to contain broader unified-cache behavior that covers the reported contract, but the exact introducing fix was not identifiable from the prepared shallow/grafted checkout.
